entry: Hit the gym before class for the first time in a week. Felt good after, but the afternoon dragged. Got through most of my to-do list.
Slept in. Called Mom for an hour and cooked dal and rice like she makes it. Felt really grounded today.
Sunday scaries. Spent almost 4 hours on my phone and didn't start the assignment due tomorrow. Annoyed at myself.
Stayed up till 2am to finish the assignment. Three coffees to survive the day. Submitted it, but it isn't my best work.
Got a rejection email from a company I really wanted. Skipped lunch and scrolled LinkedIn seeing everyone's offers. Felt like I'm behind.
Walked along the river with Priya and told her about the rejection. She's been through the same thing. Felt so much lighter after.
Did 2 hours of deep work before checking my phone and got more done than in the whole of Monday. Gym in the evening.
Said yes to helping a teammate debug, then to a club meeting, then to a call. Didn't touch my own work at all. Need to say no more.
Went hiking with phone on airplane mode. Meal-prepped for the week when I got back. Best day in a while.
Anxious about the week again, but this time I sat down and planned it out day by day. The anxiety went down once it was on paper.
Sent two applications and did a mock interview. Stumbled on a system design question but the feedback was useful.
Doomscrolled in bed until 1:30am. Exhausted all day, skipped the gym. Same pattern as last Sunday.
Formed a hackathon team! Excited but nervous that I'm not as strong as the others. We have a good idea though.
Built the first prototype and it actually works. Felt competent and in flow for hours. Forgot to eat dinner until 10pm.
